reason: My evenings are already sorted — same bar, same people, and that costs me almost nothing. I'd maybe download it to scroll, but I'm not paying 700 Lek for a concert ticket when my whole going-out budget is a few drinks a week.
objection: I've seen this before — the government TEA app had three events and died. Why would this one be full of things, and full of people I actually know?
would_change_my_mind: If my friends were already on it and I saw a specific event with people from my crew going, I'd join a free one — and after a couple of good free evenings I might trust it with ticket money.
